void AddActors ( String  selection )

Sent when a geometry or collaborative actor is created.

Parameters:
selectionas Selection, specifies the actor. For example:

By name: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
</CLitSelection>

By ID: 

<CLitSelection Name="">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#
</CLitSelection>
void AddGenericAnimation ( String  stepPropMap )

Sent when a generic animation is created via the workshop panel, or when a generic animation is moved via the timeline (remove then add).

Parameters:
stepPropMapas String, containing the description of the added step in XML. For example:

<Step Name="Roll" ReadOnly="0" ShowStartEnd="1">
  <Modifiables/>
  <Motions>
    <Motion Name="Translate">
      <PropSet>
        <Motion.Start Value="0"/>
        <Motion.End Value="4"/>
        <Motion.Distance Value="150"/>
        <Motion.Axis X="1.0" Y="0.0" Z="0"/>
      </PropSet>
    </Motion>
        <Motion Name="Rotate">
      <PropSet>
        <Motion.Start Value="0"/>
        <Motion.End Value="4"/>
        <Motion.Angle Value="90"/>
        <Motion.Axis X="0.0" Y="1.0" Z="0"/>
      </PropSet>
    </Motion>
  </Motions>
</Step>

void DeleteGenericAnimation ( String  stepPropMap )

Sent when a generic animation is deleted via the timeline (DEL or right-click/Remove), or when a generic animation is removed, and then added, via the timeline (remove then add).

Parameters:
stepPropMapas String, containing the description of the added step in XML. For example:

<Step Name="Roll" ReadOnly="0" ShowStartEnd="1">
  <Modifiables/>
  <Motions>
    <Motion Name="Translate">
      <PropSet>
        <Motion.Start Value="0"/>
        <Motion.End Value="4"/>
        <Motion.Distance Value="150"/>
        <Motion.Axis X="1.0" Y="0.0" Z="0"/>
      </PropSet>
    </Motion>
        <Motion Name="Rotate">
      <PropSet>
        <Motion.Start Value="0"/>
        <Motion.End Value="4"/>
        <Motion.Angle Value="90"/>
        <Motion.Axis X="0.0" Y="1.0" Z="0"/>
      </PropSet>
    </Motion>
  </Motions>
</Step>

void SelectFromSelectionSets ( String  SelectionSet )

Sent when a user selects a selection set in the Assembly pane or in the Collaboration pane.

Parameters:
SelectionSetas Selection, specifies the selection sets. For example:

By name: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelection Name="Selection 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
<CLitModifiable Name="Body02"/>
</CLitSelection>
</CLitList>

By ID: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelection Name="Selection 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#1kb9b30b4884ac24#
</CLitSelection>
</CLitList>


Note: This event is sent only when the selection set itself is selected in the Assembly pane or in the Collaboration pane. It is not sent if all the actors that make up the selection set are selected individually, whether in the viewport, in the Assembly pane or the Collaboration pane.

void UpdateHotspot ( String  Selection )

Sent when the user updates a user-defined hotspot. Update means when actor(s) are added or removed from a hotspot or when a hotspot is renamed.

Parameters:
Selectionas Selection, specifies the hotspot. For example:

By name: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelectionHotSpot Name="Hotspot 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
<CLitModifiable Name="Body02"/>
</CLitSelectionHotSpot>
</CLitList>

By ID: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelectionHotSpot Name="Hotspot 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#1kb9b30b4884ac24#
</CLitSelectionHotSpot>
</CLitList>


Note: If we remove the last actor from the Hotspot, DeleteHotspot will be fired and not UpdateHotspot

void UpdateSelectionSet ( String  Selection )

Sent when the user updates a selection set. Update means when actor(s) are added or removed from a selection set or when a selection set is renamed.

Parameters:
Selectionas Selection, specifies the selection sets. For example:

By name: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelection Name="Selection 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
<CLitModifiable Name="Body01"/>
<CLitModifiable Name="Body02"/>
</CLitSelection>
</CLitList>

By ID: 

<CLitList>
<CLitSelection Name="Selection 1" Ident="8eb2476cf5002b9d">
8cb9b30b4874ac23#1kb9b30b4884ac24#
</CLitSelection>
</CLitList>


Note: If we remove the last actor from the Selection Set, DeleteSelectionSet will be fired and not UpdateSelectionSet
